product_one_liner.value: SMS-Magic provides multichannel business messaging across SMS, MMS, WhatsApp, Facebook and Line for sales and marketing representatives and customer-service agents.

employee_band.notes: Tracxn reports 312 employees as of May 31, 2026.

hq_location.notes: The contact page designates Henderson, Nevada as Global/USA headquarters and Pune as the EMEA/APAC development center.

eng_blog.notes: The blog index shows messaging advice, marketing, compliance and product-use posts, not two qualifying engineering-authored implementation posts.

public_docs.notes: The public technical resource center includes messaging guides, product documentation, release notes, FAQs and REST API documentation.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The official job board lists open positions, but none has a qualifying AI, ML or data-science title.

model_provider.notes: Documentation describes connecting customers' existing OpenAI models through an API key and optional Assistant ID; it does not identify a default model.

compliance_certs.notes: The page names ISO 27001:2013 certification and HIPAA/GDPR compliance; the latter are compliance claims rather than equivalent certification schemes.

last_funding.notes: Tracxn reports no recorded funding rounds.

raised_18mo.notes: No funding rounds are recorded in the cited company profile.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: A live Team Lead – Account Executive posting for Conversive (SMS Magic) in Pune includes an application option.

launched_6mo.notes: The October 26, 2026 release introduced enhanced consent management covering collection, validation and reporting.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: No qualifying change was verified within the requested window. Available leadership listings were incomplete or undated, so they could not establish a reliable negative.

crm_stack_signal.notes: The subprocessor list names Salesforce for customer relationship management and Pardot for marketing data management.
